<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
require '/workspace/scratch/8f6c1df8ef3b/di/tests/bootstrap.php';
use Componenta\DI\Attribute\Composition\{AttributeDefinition,AttributeDefinitionRegistry,AttributePlanBuilder,AttributeCompositionRuleInterface,AttributeUsage,AttributeSet};
use Componenta\DI\Exception\AttributeCompositionException;
final class OracleNoOpRule implements AttributeCompositionRuleInterface {
 public int $calls=0;
 public function validate(AttributeUsage $attribute,AttributeSet $set):void { ++$this->calls; }
}
function permutations(array $items): iterable {
 if($items===[]) { yield []; return; }
 foreach($items as $i=>$item){ $rest=$items; unset($rest[$i]); foreach(permutations(array_values($rest)) as $suffix){yield [$item,...$suffix];} }
}
function oracle(array $edges,array $declaration): ?array {
 // Enumerating permutations in declaration order defines the independently computed
 // lexicographically first valid execution sequence, without implementing Kahn's algorithm.
 foreach(permutations($declaration) as $candidate){
  $positions=array_flip($candidate); $valid=true;
  foreach($edges as [$before,$after]){if($positions[$before]>=$positions[$after]){$valid=false;break;}}
  if($valid)return $candidate;
 }
 return null;
}
mt_srand(2026111503);
$checks=0;$cycles=0;$graphs=60;$perGraphModes=2;
for($graph=0;$graph<$graphs;++$graph){
 $names=[];
 for($i=0;$i<5;++$i){$name='OrderOracle_'.$graph.'_'.$i;eval('#[Attribute(Attribute::TARGET_CLASS)] final class '.$name.' {}');$names[]=$name;}
 $declaration=range(0,4);shuffle($declaration);
 $target='OrderOracleTarget_'.$graph;
 eval('#['.implode(', ',array_map(static fn(int $i):string=>$names[$i],$declaration)).'] final class '.$target.' {}');
 $edges=[];
 for($i=0;$i<5;++$i){for($j=0;$j<5;++$j){if($i!==$j && mt_rand(0,5)===0)$edges[]=[$i,$j];}}
 if($graph%3===0){$edges[]=[0,1];$edges[]=[1,2];$edges[]=[2,0];}
 $expected=oracle($edges,$declaration);
 $cycles+=(int)($expected===null);
 foreach([false,true] as $uncached){
  $registry=new AttributeDefinitionRegistry();$rule=new OracleNoOpRule();
  foreach($names as $i=>$name){
   $before=[];$after=[];
   foreach($edges as [$a,$b]){if($a===$i)$before[]=$names[$b];if($b===$i)$after[]=$names[$a];}
   $registry->register(new AttributeDefinition($name,before:$before,after:$after,rules:$uncached?[$rule]:[]));
  }
  $registry->seal();$builder=new AttributePlanBuilder($registry);$reflection=new ReflectionClass($target);
  foreach([0,1] as $attempt){
   try{$plan=$builder->build($reflection);$got=array_map(static fn(AttributeUsage $u):int=>array_search($u->attributeClass,$names,true),$plan->usages);}
   catch(AttributeCompositionException $e){if(!str_contains($e->getMessage(),'contains a cycle'))throw $e;$got=null;}
   if($got!==$expected)throw new RuntimeException('Graph '.$graph.' diverged: '.json_encode([$edges,$expected,$got]));
   ++$checks;
  }
  if($uncached && $rule->calls!==10)throw new RuntimeException('Custom rules were not freshly evaluated for both attempts');
  if($uncached)++$checks;
 }
}
echo json_encode(['php'=>PHP_VERSION,'graphs'=>$graphs,'cyclic_graphs'=>$cycles,'checks'=>$checks,'status'=>'passed'],JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),"\n";

use Componenta\DI\Tests\Support\ContainerBuilder;
use Componenta\DI\Exception\ResolutionException;
final class MatrixToken { public function __construct(public int $id){} }
final class MatrixState {
 public static int $next=0;
 public static int $constructors=0;
 public static int $setups=0;
 public static bool $fail=false;
 public static array $references=[];
 public static function token(): MatrixToken { $token=new MatrixToken(++self::$next);self::$references[]=WeakReference::create($token);return $token; }
 public static function reset(): void { self::$next=self::$constructors=self::$setups=0;self::$fail=false;self::$references=[]; }
}
class MatrixParent {
 #[Init([MatrixState::class,'token'])]
 private readonly MatrixToken $same;
 public function parentToken(): MatrixToken { return $this->same; }
 public function __construct(){++MatrixState::$constructors;}
}
class MatrixBase extends MatrixParent {
 #[Init([MatrixState::class,'token'])]
 private readonly MatrixToken $same;
 public bool $configured=false;
 public function childToken(): MatrixToken { return $this->same; }
 public function configure(): void {
  if($this->childToken()===$this->parentToken())throw new LogicException('Distinct private properties collapsed');
  ++MatrixState::$setups;
  if(MatrixState::$fail)throw new RuntimeException('retry matrix');
  $this->configured=true;
 }
}
#[SetUp('configure')] final class MatrixEager extends MatrixBase {}
#[Lazy,SetUp('configure')] final class MatrixLazy extends MatrixBase {}
#[Proxy,SetUp('configure')] final class MatrixProxy extends MatrixBase {}
#[NoConstructor,SetUp('configure')] final class MatrixNoConstructor extends MatrixBase {}
#[NoConstructor,Lazy,SetUp('configure')] final class MatrixLazyNoConstructor extends MatrixBase {}
#[NoConstructor,Proxy,SetUp('configure')] final class MatrixProxyNoConstructor extends MatrixBase {}
#[Attribute] final class MatrixUncachedMarker{}
final class MatrixRule implements AttributeCompositionRuleInterface { public function validate(AttributeUsage $attribute,AttributeSet $set): void{} }
$checks=0;
function check(bool $condition,string $message):void { global $checks;if(!$condition)throw new RuntimeException($message);++$checks; }
foreach([false,true] as $uncached){
 foreach([MatrixEager::class,MatrixLazy::class,MatrixProxy::class,MatrixNoConstructor::class,MatrixLazyNoConstructor::class,MatrixProxyNoConstructor::class] as $class){
  MatrixState::reset();$builder=new ContainerBuilder();
  if($uncached)$builder->addAttributeDefinition(new AttributeDefinition(MatrixUncachedMarker::class,rules:[new MatrixRule()]));
  $container=$builder->build();$deferred=str_contains($class,'Lazy')||str_contains($class,'Proxy');$skip=str_contains($class,'NoConstructor');
  check($container->has($class),'has failed');check(MatrixState::$next===0 && MatrixState::$constructors===0 && MatrixState::$setups===0,'has evaluated runtime');
  MatrixState::$fail=true;$entry=null;$error=null;
  try {$entry=$container->get($class);$entry->configured;throw new LogicException('failure was swallowed');}
  catch(ResolutionException $error){check(str_contains($error->getMessage(),'retry matrix'),'cause missing');}
  unset($error);
  gc_collect_cycles();
  check(count(MatrixState::$references)===2,'failed attempt field count');
  foreach(MatrixState::$references as $ref)check($ref->get()===null,'failed property value retained');
  MatrixState::$fail=false;$retry=$container->get($class);
  check($retry->configured===true,'retry not configured');
  check($retry->childToken()->id===3 && $retry->parentToken()->id===4,'retry reused arguments or changed field order');
  check(MatrixState::$setups===2,'setup rerun count');
  check(MatrixState::$constructors===($skip?0:2),'constructor policy count');
  check($container->get($class)===$retry,'get not shared');
  if($deferred)check($entry===$retry,'retry changed lazy identity');
  $fresh=$container->make($class);check($fresh->configured===true,'fresh not configured');check($fresh!==$retry,'make shared');
  check($fresh->childToken()->id===5 && $fresh->parentToken()->id===6,'fresh private values reused');
  $freshRef=WeakReference::create($fresh);unset($fresh);gc_collect_cycles();check($freshRef->get()===null,'metadata retained fresh object');
  check(MatrixState::$references[4]->get()===null && MatrixState::$references[5]->get()===null,'metadata retained property values');
  unset($entry,$retry,$container,$builder);gc_collect_cycles();
  foreach(MatrixState::$references as $ref)check($ref->get()===null,'container retirement retained property values');
 }
}

data.kind: read-only review of existing benchmark code and methodology

execution.method: Source inspection only, as requested. Parent-reported benchmark smoke runs are not claimed as executions by this review.

anchors.text: Counts cover only unavailable fixture names

files.purpose: Measure ordinary make/shared-get in clean containers versus containers that have observed one or eight deliberately unavailable attribute names.
files.comparable_paths: All measured operations target the same NoArguments class. The contamination fixture is made before timing. Each case/round creates an independent container; shared get is primed by warmup.
files.warmup_and_samples: Positive integer environment inputs are validated. Untimed warmup is min(2000, iterations). Case order alternates forward/reverse by round; GC occurs outside timing. Raw per-round latency/count samples are kept during execution, with medians and count ranges printed.
files.identifiers_and_labels: Six IDs distinguish make/get and clean/one/eight missing names. The counting autoloader is prepended and counts only normalized names from the eight fixtures. Counts mean autoload requests for these missing names, not filesystem reads, all framework autoload activity or successful loads.
files.result_validation: Asserts fixture names remain undefined before and after relevant work, including class/interface/trait checks without autoload. Result type/identity of make/get is not asserted inside the harness. Loader unregisters in finally.
files.mutable_state: Fresh containers isolate missing-name registries across cases. PHP class state and Composer negative lookups are process-global, but the names are guaranteed to remain missing and the first discovery is outside timing. Alternating order reduces rather than eliminates process-order noise.
files.source_origin: Common source-selection loader plus printed PHP binary/version/architecture and OPcache/JIT settings. Timings intentionally include the counting callback, as the final output explicitly states.
files.conclusion: Strongest controls of the existing timing harnesses for its specific missing-attribute-polling question. Counts and timings remain instrumented synthetic workload results.

files.purpose: Repeated total bootstrap for an empty configuration and one fixed representative configuration.
files.comparable_paths: Both cases create Config, Environment, DependencyDefinitions and ContainerFactory through the same public path. Representative input includes one service, factory, invokable, alias and delegator. Registration work is timed; resolving these services afterward is not.
files.warmup_and_samples: Up to 500 untimed builds per case, seven rounds, explicit GC before each timer. Defaults are 20000 builds, clamped to at least 1000. The measured loop includes discarding created containers and any automatic GC occurring inside it.
files.identifiers_and_labels: build/empty and build/representative label total bootstrap. Despite the filename, individual internal build phases are not isolated.
files.result_validation: buildContainer has an object return type. No post-build service/alias/factory/delegator resolution oracle is included, so successful timing alone would not detect omitted configuration work.
files.mutable_state: Each operation creates a new container, but the same input factory/delegator closure objects are reused. Their fixture behavior is stateless. Process metadata/classes are warm and cases have a fixed order.
files.source_origin: Uses the common source-selection loader and requires ContainerFactory, so this file is not an implicit v4 ContainerBuilder adapter.
files.conclusion: Appropriate for warm repeated-bootstrap cost with independent configuration contracts; not a pure constructor-only, first-process startup or per-phase breakdown measurement.

files.purpose: Handwritten explicit factory versus reflection-backed make for the same small constructor fixture, with default values and a number override.
files.comparable_paths: Both paths construct BenchmarkEntry with a shared BenchmarkDependency and matching concrete fields for the supplied workload. Factory has an explicit direct constructor path; reflection performs its own plan/resolution responsibilities. The file does not run a code generator or establish general semantic equivalence.
files.warmup_and_samples: Each of four make operations has up to 2000 untimed warmup operations and seven timed rounds. The two printed container-build measurements precede this warmup, each has one sample, and reflection always runs first.
files.identifiers_and_labels: Output labels accurately say reflection/default, factory/default and override. Despite the historical filename, generated-code compilation is not measured. Ratio is factory latency divided by reflection latency, not a speedup multiplier in the reverse direction.
files.result_validation: Container type is checked. BenchmarkEntry type, property values, dependency identity and default/override equivalence are not independently asserted by this harness.
files.mutable_state: The two containers are separate. The dependency is shared within each container. All timed loops use fixed immutable scalar inputs and a stateless factory. Fixed case ordering and shared process class/allocator state remain methodological limits.
files.source_origin: Uses the same pre-Composer source-selection loader; optional paths default to the repository source/vendor.
files.conclusion: Known first-load bias invalidates a fair cold-start interpretation of the two one-off build figures. Warm make measurements retain their narrower explicit-factory/reflection interpretation.

files.purpose: Compare prepareTargets, resolveTargets and reuse of resolvePrepared for fixed one-, three- and six-parameter methods.
files.comparable_paths: All required scalar/array/mixed parameters are explicitly provided, including null for mixed f. Reflection and targets are built outside each timed loop. Current resolveTargets implementation calls prepareTargets then resolvePrepared; the comparison therefore measures preparation overhead versus reuse, not a separate unprepared semantic engine.
files.warmup_and_samples: Up to 2000 untimed operations per case, seven timed rounds with explicit GC between rounds. The prepared plan and targets are intentionally held for the whole method group.
files.identifiers_and_labels: Unique method/prepare, method/resolve-targets and method/resolve-prepared IDs match the APIs invoked. No constructor, callback execution, autowiring, attributes or reflection-object allocation is included in these resolve loops.
files.result_validation: ParametersResolver bootstrap service type is checked. The resulting argument arrays are not compared with expected ordered values or with each other within the harness.
files.mutable_state: Provided values and method signatures are constant, and no availability or resolver registration changes occur. It intentionally measures stable prepared metadata with common warmed resolver caches.
files.source_origin: Uses the common source-selection loader; the file requires the current prepareTargets/resolvePrepared APIs.
files.conclusion: Narrow steady-plan diagnostic; does not establish correctness parity, cold metadata costs or request/autowiring performance by itself.

anchors.text: // Finish comparable cases before creating feature-only container graphs.

files.purpose: Steady-state container build/get/make/call cases, plus feature-only Transform/SetUp/union cases when Transform exists.
files.comparable_paths: The common cases complete before feature-only containers are built. v4 uses ContainerBuilder; current versions use ContainerFactory. This compares each version public construction path, not an identical private implementation.
files.warmup_and_samples: Up to 2000 untimed operations precede seven timed rounds per case; explicit cycle collection occurs before each timer. One container and its shared dependency are intentionally reused for warm get/make/call. Build repeatedly creates and releases containers.
files.identifiers_and_labels: Common and feature case names are unique. get/shared is warmed before timing; make is fresh construction. Runtime callback constants keep the file parseable on 8.4 and do not measure native 8.5 attribute-expression identity. DI_BENCH_CASES filters exact comma-separated labels; an unmatched selection is not rejected.
files.result_validation: Checks ContainerFactory result type and rejects successful execution of the ambiguous-union case. Other operation values, exact result classes, get identity, fresh make identity and callback counts are not checked in this harness. The union error case accepts any ResolutionException, so the harness itself is not a semantic ambiguity oracle.
files.mutable_state: The shared container/callable identity and already resolved Dependency are deliberately warm. No fixture mutates definitions, callback routing or dependency state during timed rounds. Cases run in a fixed order, and metadata/global allocator state can carry over.
files.source_origin: Uses the common source-selection loader before declaring fixture classes. Benchmark namespace is excluded from production-source assertions.
files.conclusion: Usable for labeled warm-path diagnostics with independent correctness gates and controlled external process ordering; no new current-path defect established.

files.purpose: Select one DI source directory before Composer can eagerly load DI helper functions or optimized classmap entries, while using a supplied dependency installation.
files.comparable_paths: Canonicalizes selected source/autoload paths, derives original DI source prefixes from generated PSR-4 data, remaps PSR-0/PSR-4/classmap paths and Composer eager files, and leaves dependency paths intact.
files.warmup_and_samples: Per-process bootstrap work precedes benchmark timers. The loader is not itself a measured operation.
files.identifiers_and_labels: Source checks include production DI declarations and user functions, excluding benchmark/test namespaces. Container.php gets an exact-file precheck. Shutdown output records source path and checked declaration/function counts.
files.result_validation: Rejects foreign already-loaded DI symbols before loading, foreign remapped classmap entries, a wrong Container source and foreign declarations/functions at shutdown. This addresses the optimized-classmap and eager-files hazards that a late PSR-4 override cannot repair.
files.mutable_state: Registers its loader first and honors Composer eager-file IDs. Intended use is a fresh benchmark process; it is not a general PHP sandbox or a way to replace already-declared foreign DI symbols.
files.source_origin: Checks actual Reflection filenames and canonical source directory boundaries, but does not hash every source file, pin a commit, or prove dependency-lock equivalence. Those invariants belong to the external experiment/evidence collector.
files.conclusion: No source-leak defect established for the reviewed benchmark fixtures. Historical cross-version CI selects the corresponding version vendor; arbitrary mixed-major Composer maps need their own validity checks.

confirmed_findings.classification: previously documented methodological limitation, not a new hidden runtime defect
confirmed_findings.problem: The two one-off container-build measurements do not have comparable initial process state. Reflection always runs first and includes first class loading of ContainerFactory and its bootstrap graph, while factory runs afterward; neither measurement has build warmup or repeated sampling.
confirmed_findings.evidence: Read control flow from reflectionBuildStarted through factoryBuildMilliseconds; later benchmark() warmup only applies to make-loop measurements. Common source loader preloads Container, not the entire ContainerFactory graph.
confirmed_findings.impact: These printed values cannot support a fair reflection-versus-factory cold-start comparison. This does not invalidate the separately warmed make-loop measurements or the fresh controlled microbenchmarks in the current audit.
confirmed_findings.disposition: Parent acknowledged the existing limitation; do not change the main checkout, rerun CI, or use these one-off build figures in the new performance conclusions.

limitations.detail: These files are timing harnesses, not independent correctness suites. Most return values and identities are discarded. Runtime ambiguous-union timing accepts any ResolutionException rather than checking the precise ambiguity condition. Existing full contracts/smoke evidence are needed before timing results can be interpreted; no current wrong result was established in this read-only pass.

An unmatched RuntimeBench DI_BENCH_CASES filter can yield no measured rows with a successful script exit. Published uses inspected here do not rely on a mistyped filter; this is not asserted to be an observed failure.

Most scripts use seven rounds and output only a median with fixed case order. They neither alternate baseline/candidate processes nor provide confidence intervals. AttributeAvailability alternates case ordering and prints count ranges. Controlled process ordering, raw logs, runtime settings and variance interpretation remain the responsibility of the surrounding experiment.

Warmups deliberately populate class/metadata and shared-dependency state. Build loops create and discard objects, so automatic GC/disposal during timing may contribute. These results must not be relabeled as first-process startup, pure constructor cost or whole-application throughput.

GeneratedVsReflection compares an explicit handwritten factory with reflection-backed creation; no generator is executed and full semantic equivalence is not established. BuildPhases measures total bootstrap rather than independent phases. ParameterPlan measures prepared-target APIs with all inputs already supplied, not full request or callback execution.

The loader checks canonical origins of loaded production symbols, including eager functions and optimized maps. It does not itself pin source hashes/commits or dependency-lock equality. Cross-version experiments still need immutable source identities and valid version-appropriate dependency metadata.
Counts cover requests for exactly eight absent fixture names and timings include the counting loader. They do not measure filesystem I/O or uninstrumented application latency.

additional_context_reads.scope: targets/prepareTargets/resolveTargets/resolvePrepared control flow; confirmed resolveTargets prepares then resolves.
Only benchmark job excerpt: v4 uses its own vendor while current code uses its own vendor. Full workflow review belongs to parent.
Relevant benchmark and consumer passages; historical evidence is not reclassified as a new run.
loadClass/findFile behavior for source-origin reasoning; dependency file is outside benchmark scope.

data.conclusion: All six requested files were read in full. One known, already disclosed first-load comparison limitation was reconfirmed. No new confirmed production defect or wrong-source execution in the reviewed benchmark paths was established. No code was optimized or edited and no timings/tests were run.

data.scope: Independent bounded security-boundary synthesis after the production and test-quality audit; exact source/test anchors, not a formal Codex Security scan.

security_policy.lookup: Case-insensitive tracked SECURITY.md/.rst/.txt inventory plus root-file existence. No component policy found.

data.summary: No new exploitable production defect was established in this bounded review. Request provenance/source guards, core registration ownership and mutation publication integrity are evidenced below. Native trusted PHP execution and complete-Throwable disclosure are outside those guarantees.

boundaries.title: HTTP data and application configuration
boundaries.conclusion: Body/query/header/cookie/file values are data from the HTTP boundary. The declared PHP attributes, DTO type, mapping rules, config, definitions, callbacks, custom resolvers, external providers and autoloaders are application-controlled code/configuration. No authentication of a value is implied by its selected source.

source_evidence.meaning: Mapping sources, renames, casts, defaults and conflict policy are attribute configuration.
Payload/query/header/cookie/attribute/server/file bags are read from the supplied PSR-7 request.
The DTO class comes from reflected declared parameter types, not a request field; ambiguous class targets are rejected.
String callable resolution intentionally admits configured service IDs, native functions and class methods.
Accepted native callables execute normally via call_user_func_array; target exceptions propagate.
Configured extension factories are called with the actual container.

limitations: A header is not trusted merely because a fixture calls its value trusted. Source authority prevents source mixing; authentication/authorization remain application policy.
The authenticity of request attributes and server/proxy fields depends on the middleware and request construction, not on the DI attribute.

Feeding attacker-selected callable names, definitions, class names or dependency configuration into execution/registration APIs crosses the application trust boundary. The DI component is not a PHP sandbox.
Trusted callbacks/autoloaders can perform arbitrary application I/O, reenter the container, throw, or not terminate. No separate attacker-controlled path was established for such behavior.

boundaries.title: Mapped source-conflict and argument guards
boundaries.conclusion: Mapped HTTP keys cannot silently override an explicitly declared parameter source in the normal reflection/object/setup lifecycle. Conflicts are rejected before DTO factory dispatch, and provenance is checked again at applicable runtime boundaries.

source_evidence.meaning: Mapping sequence is raw extraction, named-key check, optional raw validation, transformation, second named-key check, source check and factory dispatch.
Source-conflict check is performed before factory->make.
Integer keys are forbidden for DTO transport, including after a mapper transformation.
Initial conflict check uses array_key_exists, so a supplied null is still a supplied conflicting key.
The guarded key set includes the parameter name and declared class/interface type names.
Source classification follows ParameterSourceAttributeInterface, not arbitrary attribute names.
Reflection creation checks mapped provenance against the actual constructed class.
The public parameter execution context is created only after the runtime boundary check.
Changed metadata triggers a renewed provenance boundary and completed-work check.
Callback setup carries the diagnostic owner to the common callback invoker.

test_evidence.meaning: Body token cannot shadow the declared Header source.
Conflict occurs with zero custom resolveParameter calls; a same-resolver positive control then proves it is active.
Both pre-transform and post-transform positional DTO transport keys are rejected.
Later-discovered sources reject conflicts without an additional DTO factory call, cold/warm and cached/non-memoized.
After warmup, conflicting name and type keys fail without target-body execution or cross-container retention.
Classless setup callback source guards cover EntryId name/type keys and Env names.
A dependency-loaded late source preserves the classless callback owner and suppresses callback execution.

limitations: Ordinary programmatic make/call overrides are not automatically marked as HTTP input; application adapters must use the intended mapping boundary.

Explicit ClassDefinition uses its explicit definition lifecycle. It intentionally does not activate parameter attributes on its concrete target; this is trusted configuration, not a security guard bypass by a request.

supports() is metadata classification and may execute during preparation before the value-resolution boundary. The no-side-effect observation here concerns resolveParameter and target/factory dispatch.
A property-only attribute such as Init is not a parameter source marker. Do not claim the guard enforces arbitrary application property invariants.

boundaries.title: Request merges, transport and private provenance
boundaries.conclusion: Configured sources have explicit merge behavior; mapping collisions are rejected. The real request transport and internal provenance are supplied by the library and are filtered before public extension calls.

source_evidence.meaning: Different values for a shared source key are rejected by default; identical values and explicit FirstWins are deliberate accepted cases.
Multiple rename sources cannot silently overwrite the same mapped target.
Rename cannot silently replace an unrelated existing input key.
The optional sort transform chooses a configured sortMap entry; it does not execute a request-provided expression.
Mapping assigns the actual request object to its transport key.
Provenance is an internally constructed typed object holding mapped key names, not caller-supplied array flags.
Every NUL-prefixed componenta.di metadata key is stripped before public parameter contexts.
Public setup overrides cannot replace retained internal metadata.
Custom definition strategies receive public parameters only.
External entry resolver parameters are filtered; only the exact internal composite/reflection implementations retain internal context.

test_evidence.meaning: Explicit and fallback custom providers receive the exact expected public bag with a private key removed.
Classless callback resolver receives exactly the public value and original request, with no private owner/provenance key.
Different values from selected request sources fail under the default policy.
Warmed extractor plans use the current sources and authoritative request identity.

limitations: Private metadata filtering is an API integrity/lifetime boundary, not secrecy from arbitrary trusted PHP code using reflection or deliberately calling internal helpers.
Validation is optional and validates raw DTO data before mapper transforms; application schemas and output encoding/sanitization are separate responsibilities.
FirstWins and broad source/wildcard selection are explicit application configuration choices, not remotely selected fallback policies.
Generic map/exclude rules use actual source keys. Header case normalization is not a universal mapper guarantee.

boundaries.title: Protected services and mutation capability
boundaries.conclusion: Protected service IDs retain composition-root ownership through declarative registration, runtime set/alias/delegator operations and external lookup. Attached composites require the owning container mutation authority and reject foreign prepared bindings.

source_evidence.meaning: Exact protected IDs cover container/config/metadata/pipeline services and execution/factory interfaces.
Configured bindings and alias-canonicalized delegators are checked for protected/ambiguous ownership before construction.
Bootstrap accepts only listed typed infrastructure services.
The container creates and retains its private mutation authority before attaching the composite.
Runtime set checks both requested and canonical protected IDs.
Alias mutation validates a candidate graph and prevents protected alias replacement/delegator retargeting.
Delegator registration checks protection again after callable preparation/autoload.
External get is bypassed for protected requested/canonical IDs and alias routing is rechecked after external has.
The availability path independently performs the corresponding protected-ID recheck.
Direct setDefinition is forbidden once the root is attached.
An attached root cannot be imported as a child snapshot.
Publication validates prepared-binding owner and exact authority identity before state change.

test_evidence.meaning: All listed core IDs reject set, alias replacement and decoration.
Aliases targeting protected IDs retain set/delegator protection.
External providers cannot shadow direct protected IDs or aliases, while ordinary external entries still work.
External ownership callback retargeting to protected core causes zero external get calls.
An attached root rejects direct mutation, second attachment and child import while the legitimate container path works.
Missing and forged publication capabilities fail without changing either container or root binding.
Prepared bindings cannot publish into another composite.

limitations: Protection concerns registration/routing identities. It is not an authorization system for consumers that already hold the container.
A permitted alias to a protected service may expose that service; this is not replacement of it.
Explicit runtime argument values can intentionally satisfy dependencies; protected registration does not prohibit every explicit per-call override.
The opaque authority protects supported API mutation paths, not against malicious PHP with reflection access in the same process.

boundaries.title: Raw set and configured execution
boundaries.conclusion: Container::set interprets only DefinitionInterface values as a definition; other values are stored as raw shared entries. This avoids silently treating ordinary callable-shaped runtime values as factory configuration.

source_evidence.meaning: Only the DefinitionInterface branch performs definition preparation.
The alternate branch replaces the shared base with the literal value.
Raw value replacement retains the old root then stores the supplied value without invoking it.
Explicit parameter name/position values are type-checked literal arguments.
A typed override must be an object satisfying both the key type and the target declaration.

test_evidence.meaning: Raw shared replacement preserves the separate fresh definition and caller-held references.
Runtime array values replace configured references and remain literal.

limitations: Calling container->call on a callable raw entry is still an explicit trusted execution decision.
Raw set overrides shared get behavior without redefining the fresh make lifecycle; callers must not infer a fresh-definition replacement from a raw value write.

boundaries.title: Diagnostic data and exception propagation
boundaries.conclusion: DI-owned diagnostic payloads use scalar names/types instead of retaining request, reflection and service objects. This reduces accidental payload retention; it does not make a complete Throwable safe to disclose publicly.

source_evidence.meaning: The class explicitly documents PHP-owned stack traces and their runtime-dependent retention.
Parameter diagnostics snapshot names, positions, type and declaration context.
Provided values are summarized with get_debug_type rather than copied into diagnostic fields.
A service failure message includes previous->getMessage and preserves the cause.
Parameter/property suffixes may include the original exception class/message.
Callable descriptions reduce objects/closures to type labels, but preserve string callable names and method text.
Source conflicts contain key/source labels, not field values.
Parameter-source conflicts contain key/source/class/parameter names.
Componenta failures preserve identity; foreign get failures are normalized with the original cause.
has deliberately returns false for a thrown availability failure; it is not a proof that a service can successfully execute.

test_evidence.meaning: After exception references are dropped, failed closure/request resolution does not leave objects retained by the container.
Callable diagnostic fields contain descriptions and types.
Property diagnostic tests explicitly preserve cause messages.
Foreign registration failure preserves cause, old binding and successful retry behavior.

limitations: No generic secret-redaction, escaping or output-size bound is applied to IDs, field names, callable descriptions or upstream exception messages.
A previous Throwable or PHP trace can retain or reveal sensitive values independently of the scalar DI payload. Throwable trace-argument capture is runtime policy.
Applications should emit a public error representation and apply their log redaction/encoding policy rather than serializing the full diagnostic/cause/trace to a client.
The retained-exception tests drop the exception before GC; they do not promise that a live Throwable is free of PHP-owned references.

boundaries.title: Failure atomicity and retired-value release
boundaries.conclusion: Definition admission precedes publication, and mutation state/caches are updated before obsolete roots are released. Destructor exceptions report committed mutation instead of leaving a partially invalidated alias/cache graph.

source_evidence.meaning: Definition validation can fail before outer publication; its error keeps the original cause.
Publication/base replacement and all associated invalidations precede retirement release.
Revision checks prevent a suspended/outdated result from repopulating a newer shared entry.
Release becomes idempotent before dropping retained roots, catches each synchronously delivered failure and continues releasing direct roots.
The failure explicitly identifies that mutation committed and preserves ordered causes.

test_evidence.meaning: Fresh/shared results show the new definition despite a retired-factory exception.
Throwing retired wrappers cannot leave a sibling alias with old results.
A nested mutation during retirement remains current after outer failure.
Suspended retirement performs no stale writes after a newer mutation.
All directly retained roots are released in order and synchronous failures are collected.
Container ownership is dropped without forcing collection of application cycles.
A nested write during validation is intentionally preserved whether the outer validation is rejected or committed.

limitations: A retirement exception means the mutation already committed; an application must not treat every thrown registration exception as rollback.
Admission does not roll back intentional nested mutations performed by trusted application callbacks.
Only directly retained roots and synchronous delivered exceptions are controlled. The library does not traverse arbitrary nested graphs, force GC, zero memory or control process shutdown.
Source/resource limits and termination of arbitrary application callbacks are not guaranteed by this mechanism.

current_audit_fix_classification.classification: Callable routing correctness/lifetime fix; changing a referenced callable owner/method can no longer alter an existing adapter. No remote attacker-to-callback path was established here.

Reentrant provider ownership correctness fix. Visits newly appended providers in the same operation without repeating old has calls and preserves first-owner precedence. Trusted providers that keep appending indefinitely were not promoted to a remote DoS finding without an untrusted-input path.
Test-oracle strengthening; production already guard-first. Isolated deliberate mutant proved the previous assertion missed premature resolver side effects.

verification.method: Read and cross-check source/tests, reused prior audit evidence and mutation proof. No new tests, network probes, attacks, formal plugin scan, or main-checkout edits in this phase.
verification.core_reviewer_crosscheck: Core reviewer independently confirmed trusted-extension boundary, post-external-has protection, attached-root authority, and that appended-provider bug is correctness/ownership rather than a proven untrusted exploit.

limitations: Bounded code/test review does not prove absence of all vulnerabilities.
The application adapters, authentication middleware, web error handlers, production PHP settings and downstream consumers are not assessed here.
Protected root integrity and private metadata filtering do not sandbox arbitrary PHP code executing in the same process.

final readonly class TextDefinition implements DefinitionInterface
{
    public function __construct(public string $value) {}
}

final readonly class ValidatedText implements DefinitionInterface
{
    public function __construct(public string $value) {}
}

final class TextStrategy implements DefinitionResolverInterface
{
    public function supportsDefinition(DefinitionInterface $definition): bool
    {
        return $definition instanceof TextDefinition;
    }

    public function validateDefinition(string $id, DefinitionInterface $definition): DefinitionInterface
    {
        if (!$definition instanceof TextDefinition || trim($definition->value) === '') {
            throw new InvalidConfigurationException('A nonempty text definition is required.');
        }

        return new ValidatedText(trim($definition->value));
    }

    public function resolveDefinition(string $id, DefinitionInterface $validated, array $params = []): mixed
    {
        if (!$validated instanceof ValidatedText) {
            throw new LogicException('Execution received an unvalidated definition.');
        }

        return $validated->value;
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

$loader = require __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';
$manifest = json_decode(file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/source-manifest.json'), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
$source = realpath(__DIR__ . '/vendor/componenta/di/src');
if ($source === false) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Missing isolated DI source.');
}
$classCount = 0;
foreach ($manifest['source_hashes'] as $relative => $hash) {
    $file = $source . '/' . $relative;
    if (hash_file('sha256', $file) !== $hash) {
        throw new RuntimeException('DI source mismatch: ' . $relative);
    }
    if ($relative === 'Internal/functions.php') {
        continue;
    }
    $class = 'Componenta\\DI\\' . str_replace('/', '\\', substr($relative, 0, -4));
    if (realpath($loader->findFile($class) ?: '') !== $file) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Stale or missing DI classmap: ' . $class);
    }
    ++$classCount;
}
foreach ($loader->getClassMap() as $class => $file) {
    if (str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\') && !str_starts_with(realpath($file) ?: '', $source . '/')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Foreign DI classmap entry: ' . $class);
    }
}
$capture = static function (string $phase) use ($source, $manifest, $classCount, $loader): void {
    $classes = [];
    foreach (array_merge(get_declared_classes(), get_declared_interfaces(), get_declared_traits()) as $class) {
        if (!str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\')) {
            continue;
        }
        $file = (new ReflectionClass($class))->getFileName();
        if ($file === false || !str_starts_with(realpath($file) ?: '', $source . '/')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Foreign loaded DI class: ' . $class);
        }
        $classes[$class] = $file;
    }
    $functions = [];
    foreach (get_defined_functions()['user'] as $function) {
        if (!str_starts_with(strtolower($function), 'componenta\\di\\')) {
            continue;
        }
        $file = (new ReflectionFunction($function))->getFileName();
        if ($file === false || realpath($file) !== $source . '/Internal/functions.php') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Foreign loaded DI function: ' . $function);
        }
        $functions[$function] = $file;
    }
    if ($functions === []) {
        throw new RuntimeException('DI functions were not loaded.');
    }
    foreach (get_included_files() as $file) {
        if (str_contains($file, '/componenta/di/src/') && !str_starts_with(realpath($file) ?: '', $source . '/')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Foreign included DI source: ' . $file);
        }
    }
    $evidence = [
        'phase' => $phase,
        'php' => PHP_VERSION,
        'di_commit' => $manifest['di_commit'],
        'source' => $source,
        'source_file_count' => count($manifest['source_hashes']),
        'source_fingerprint' => $manifest['source_fingerprint'],
        'source_fingerprint_algorithm' => $manifest['source_fingerprint_algorithm'],
        'mapped_classes' => $classCount,
        'authoritative_classmap' => $loader->isClassMapAuthoritative(),
        'loaded_classes' => $classes,
        'loaded_functions' => $functions,
    ];
    $destination = getenv('DI_INTEGRATION_PROVENANCE');
    if ($destination === false || file_put_contents($destination . '.' . $phase . '.json', json_encode($evidence, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) . "\n") === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Cannot persist integration provenance.');
    }
};
$capture('bootstrap');
register_shutdown_function(static fn() => $capture('shutdown'));

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$app = getenv('DI_AUDIT_APP_ROOT');
$manifestPath = getenv('DI_AUDIT_SOURCE_MANIFEST');
$destination = getenv('DI_AUDIT_PROVENANCE_OUTPUT');
if (!is_string($app) || !is_string($manifestPath) || !is_string($destination)) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Missing integration evidence paths.');
}
$loader = require $app . '/vendor/autoload.php';
$manifest = json_decode(file_get_contents($manifestPath), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
$source = realpath($app . '/vendor/componenta/di/src');
if ($source === false) {
    throw new RuntimeException('Missing installed DI source.');
}
$mapped = [];
foreach ($manifest['source_hashes'] as $relative => $hash) {
    $file = $source . '/' . $relative;
    if (hash_file('sha256', $file) !== $hash) {
        throw new RuntimeException('DI source hash mismatch: ' . $relative);
    }
    if ($relative === 'Internal/functions.php') {
        continue;
    }
    $class = 'Componenta\\DI\\' . str_replace('/', '\\', substr($relative, 0, -4));
    $mappedFile = $loader->findFile($class);
    if ($mappedFile === false || realpath($mappedFile) !== $file) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Foreign or missing DI class mapping: ' . $class);
    }
    $mapped[$class] = $mappedFile;
}
foreach ($loader->getClassMap() as $class => $file) {
    if (str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\') && !str_starts_with(realpath($file) ?: '', $source . '/')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Foreign DI classmap entry: ' . $class);
    }
}
$composite = new ReflectionClass(Componenta\DI\Resolver\Entry\CompositeResolver::class);
$phases = [];
$capture = static function (string $phase) use ($app, $source, $manifest, $mapped, $loader, $composite, $destination, &$phases): void {
    $diClasses = [];
    $appClasses = [];
    $anonymousTypes = [];
    foreach (array_merge(get_declared_classes(), get_declared_interfaces(), get_declared_traits()) as $class) {
        $isDi = str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\');
        $isApp = str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\App\\');
        if (!$isDi && !$isApp) {
            continue;
        }
        $reflection = new ReflectionClass($class);
        $file = $reflection->getFileName();
        $real = $file === false ? false : realpath($file);
        if ($reflection->isAnonymous()) {
            // PHP derives anonymous type names from an implemented interface.
            // App tests create such objects in temporary files removed before shutdown.
            $anonymousTypes[$class] = ['file' => $file, 'realpath' => $real];
            continue;
        }
        if ($real === false) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Missing reflected source file: ' . $class);
        }
        if ($isDi) {
            if (!str_starts_with($real, $source . '/')) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Foreign loaded DI type: ' . $class);
            }
            $diClasses[$class] = ['file' => $file, 'realpath' => $real, 'sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $file)];
        } else {
            if (!str_starts_with($real, $app . '/src/') && !str_starts_with($real, $app . '/tests/')) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Foreign loaded App type: ' . $class);
            }
            $appClasses[$class] = $real;
        }
    }
    $functions = [];
    foreach (get_defined_functions()['user'] as $function) {
        if (!str_starts_with(strtolower($function), 'componenta\\di\\')) {
            continue;
        }
        $file = (new ReflectionFunction($function))->getFileName();
        if ($file === false || realpath($file) !== $source . '/Internal/functions.php') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Foreign loaded DI function: ' . $function);
        }
        $functions[$function] = $file;
    }
    if ($functions === []) {
        throw new RuntimeException('DI functions were not loaded.');
    }
    $phases[$phase] = [
        'php' => PHP_VERSION,
        'binary' => PHP_BINARY,
        'main_head' => $manifest['main_head'],
        'source_root' => $source,
        'source_file_count' => count($manifest['source_hashes']),
        'source_fingerprint' => $manifest['source_fingerprint'],
        'mapped_class_count' => count($mapped),
        'authoritative_classmap' => $loader->isClassMapAuthoritative(),
        'composite_reflection_file' => $composite->getFileName(),
        'composite_source_sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $composite->getFileName()),
        'composer_loader_file' => (new ReflectionClass($loader))->getFileName(),
        'loaded_di_types' => $diClasses,
        'loaded_app_types' => $appClasses,
        'loaded_anonymous_fixture_types' => $anonymousTypes,
        'loaded_di_functions' => $functions,
    ];
    if (file_put_contents($destination, json_encode($phases, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) . "\n") === false) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Cannot save integration provenance.');
    }
};
$capture('bootstrap');
register_shutdown_function(static function () use ($capture, $destination, &$phases): void {
    try {
        $capture('shutdown');
    } catch (Throwable $failure) {
        $phases['shutdown_error'] = ['type' => $failure::class, 'message' => $failure->getMessage(), 'trace' => $failure->getTraceAsString()];
        file_put_contents($destination, json_encode($phases, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) . "\n");
        fwrite(STDERR, 'Integration provenance failure: ' . $failure->getMessage() . PHP_EOL);
        exit(1);
    }
});

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace ComponentaAudit\CycleGuard;

use Composer\Autoload\ClassLoader;
use ReflectionClass;
use ReflectionFunction;
use RuntimeException;

/** Select archived DI source before eager Composer files or optimized class maps. */
function loadSource(string $sourceRoot, string $vendorDirectory, ?string $testDirectory = null): ClassLoader
{
    require_once $vendorDirectory . '/composer/ClassLoader.php';
    $loader = new ClassLoader($vendorDirectory);
    $classMap = require $vendorDirectory . '/composer/autoload_classmap.php';
    foreach ($classMap as $class => $path) {
        if (!str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\')) {
            continue;
        }
        $marker = strrpos($path, '/src/');
        if (str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\Tests\\') || $marker === false) {
            unset($classMap[$class]);
            continue;
        }
        $selected = $sourceRoot . substr($path, $marker);
        if (!is_file($selected)) {
            unset($classMap[$class]);
            continue;
        }
        $classMap[$class] = $selected;
    }
    $loader->addClassMap($classMap);
    foreach (require $vendorDirectory . '/composer/autoload_psr4.php' as $prefix => $directories) {
        if (!str_starts_with($prefix, 'Componenta\\DI\\')) {
            $loader->setPsr4($prefix, $directories);
        }
    }
    $loader->setPsr4('Componenta\\DI\\', $sourceRoot . '/src');
    if ($testDirectory !== null) {
        $loader->setPsr4('Componenta\\DI\\Tests\\', $testDirectory);
    }
    foreach (require $vendorDirectory . '/composer/autoload_namespaces.php' as $prefix => $directories) {
        $loader->set($prefix, $directories);
    }
    $loader->register(true);
    foreach (require $vendorDirectory . '/composer/autoload_files.php' as $identifier => $path) {
        if ($path === dirname($vendorDirectory) . '/src/Internal/functions.php') {
            $path = $sourceRoot . '/src/Internal/functions.php';
        }
        if (!isset($GLOBALS['__composer_autoload_files'][$identifier])) {
            $GLOBALS['__composer_autoload_files'][$identifier] = true;
            require $path;
        }
    }
    return $loader;
}

/** @return array<string, mixed> */
function sourceProvenance(string $sourceRoot): array
{
    $classes = [];
    foreach ([...get_declared_classes(), ...get_declared_interfaces(), ...get_declared_traits()] as $class) {
        if (!str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\') || str_starts_with($class, 'Componenta\\DI\\Tests\\')) {
            continue;
        }
        $path = (new ReflectionClass($class))->getFileName();
        if (!is_string($path) || !str_starts_with($path, $sourceRoot . '/src/')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Wrong DI declaration source: ' . $class);
        }
        $classes[$class] = $path;
    }
    $functions = [];
    foreach (get_defined_functions()['user'] as $function) {
        if (!str_starts_with(strtolower($function), 'componenta\\di\\internal\\')) {
            continue;
        }
        $path = (new ReflectionFunction($function))->getFileName();
        if ($path !== $sourceRoot . '/src/Internal/functions.php') {
            throw new RuntimeException('Wrong DI function source: ' . $function);
        }
        $functions[$function] = $path;
    }
    if ($functions === []) {
        throw new RuntimeException('Selected DI functions were not loaded.');
    }
    return [
        'source_root' => $sourceRoot,
        'cycle_guard_sha256' => hash_file('sha256', $sourceRoot . '/src/Internal/CycleGuard.php'),
        'classes' => $classes,
        'functions' => $functions,
    ];
}
